goal: Make enforced agent-work-contract checks distinguish inherited main evidence from evidence authored for the current pull request.
prohibited_actions: Do not disable or weaken enforced mode.
Do not add Agent work contract as a required branch context before a new full green day completes.
Do not retire or weaken the legacy objects alias.
assumptions: Evidence files inherited byte-for-byte from the pull request base are not evidence authored for that pull request.
Changing both evidence files is required before their contents can govern the current pull request.
stop_conditions: Stop if the repair would allow a non-grandfathered enforced pull request with no current evidence pair to pass.
Stop if changing only one evidence file could be treated as a complete pair.
Stop if implementation requires changing database structure or data.
